title: AI Era
content:
# I am trying to remove AI from my workflow until I feel confident!

Over the past 2 years, I was trying to build and also use AI tools. I think they have been part of my workflow for around 2+ years. When I look back, I don't remember a thing. The only thing I know is that I was trying to make something visible, not to understand what it was.
I know nobody gives a shit if I coded it, vibe-coded it, or even cloned it and made it mine. But when it comes to skill and feeling good, it feels good to build it myself. I become very, very productive. I may not even sleep for 2 days and all, but it comes with a cost.
The two things that keep me from writing everything by my own hand...
While everybody is going down the AI-slop path, even non-tech people are publishing products. So why would I write code rigorously and fiercely?
On the other hand, I am not facing any challenge. Anybody can come, prompt what they need, and after some iterative process, they will get what they desired.
But for me, who thinks he is bad at coding, these AI tools are going to make you lazy and very uncomfortable when it comes to thinking and building skills.
So, from now on, I have decided to see how it will go by coding manually and figuring things out on my own.
